name: paseo-team
description: Paseo plugin that runs a coding task as a small team: a coordinator, a developer, and two cross-reviewing code reviewers behind a quality gate.
author: OliverWalker1122

scripts.format: prettier --write README.md OVERVIEW.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md paseo-plugin.json package.json tsconfig.json index.client.tsx index.server.ts "shared/**/*.ts" "server/**/*.ts" "client/**/*.{ts,tsx}" scripts/check.mjs "tests/**/*.ts" .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md OVERVIEW.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md CHANGELOG.md paseo-plugin.json package.json tsconfig.json index.client.tsx index.server.ts "shared/**/*.ts" "server/**/*.ts" "client/**/*.{ts,tsx}" scripts/check.mjs "tests/**/*.ts" .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:plugin
